Name: MiniWhenTokens
Author: jkysa88
Description:
Do NOT edit / delete this mod’s i18n filesDo NOT edit, replace, [b]or delete[/b] any i18n files included in this mod.
[b]If you delete them, this mod will NOT work.
[/b]
They are required files and are not meant to be used as your dialogue source.

Important: Any dialogue you write inside this mod’s i18n will NOT work.

Those entries exist only for reference/testing, not for real output.

✅ Put your dialogue in your own mod’s i18n or in Content Patcher (EditData), and make sure the final displayed string contains

[code][[Token:...]][/code].

[code][[Token:...]][/code] parts.

Supported Tokens (Mini Version Only)This mini build supports [b]only[/b] these tokens:

1) Indoor / Outdoor[code][[IO:in]][/code] / [code][[IO:out]][/code]
[list]
[*][code]in[/code] = indoors
[*][code]out[/code] = outdoors
(also accepts [code]indoor/indoors[/code], [code]outdoor/outdoors[/code])[/list]Example:
[list]
[*][code][[IO:in]]It's indoors.[/code]
[*][code][[IO:out]]It's outside.[/code]
[/list][line]2) Time[code][[T:...]][/code]
Time checks are based on [b]current game time[/b] ([code]Game1.timeOfDay[/code]).
Presets[list]
[*][code][[T:morning]][/code] : 06:00–11:59
[*][code][[T:noon]][/code] : 12:00–12:59
[*][code][[T:afternoon]][/code]
: 13:00–17:59[*][code][[T:evening]][/code] : 18:00–21:59
[*][code][[T:night]][/code] : 22:00–05:59 (wraps past midnight)
[/list]Negation[list]
[*][code][[T:!night]][/code] : shows only if it’s [b]NOT[/b] night
[*][code][[T:!morning]][/code] : shows only if it’s [b]NOT[/b] morning
[/list]Numeric comparisons (HHMM, 24h)[list]
[*][code][[T:>=1800]][/code] : 18:00 or later
[*][code][[T:<0900]][/code] : before 09:00
[*][code][[T:==1200]][/code] : exactly 12:00
[/list]Ranges (HHMM-HHMM)[list]
[*][code][[T:0600-0900]][/code] : 06:00–09:00
[*][code][[T:2300-0200]][/code] : 23:00–02:00 (wraps past midnight)
[/list]OR conditions (comma-separated)[list]
[*][code][[T:morning,evening]][/code] : morning [b]or[/b] evening
[*][code][[T:>=2200,<0600]][/code] : 22:00+ [b]or[/b] before 06:00 (numeric “night”)
[/list][line]3) Location[code][[L:...]][/code]
Checks the player’s [b]current location[/b] using simple keywords.
Examples:
[list]
[*][code][[L:town]]...[/code]
[*][code][[L:farm]]...[/code]
[*][code][[L:saloon]]...[/code]
[*][code][[L:forest]]...[/code]
[/list]Note: Location matching is [b]loose/keyword-based[/b] (mini implementation).
[line]4) NPC Heart Level (Speaker)[code][/code][b]4) NPC Heart Level (Friendship Hearts)[/b]
[code][[H:...]][/code]
By default, this checks the [b]speaker NPC’s[/b] heart level:
[list]
[*][code][[H:>=8]]...[/code]
[/list]✅ This mod also supports checking [b]a specific NPC by name[/b] (not necessarily the speaker):
[list]
[*][code][[H:Shane>=8]]...[/code]
[*][code][[H:Alex<4]]...[/code]
[/list]This checks the player’s friendship hearts with that named NPC, even if someone else is speaking.
[[H:Shane>=8]]Shane trusts you enough. II Default
[line]5) Nearby NPC[code][[NPCNear:...]][/code]
Checks whether specific NPCs are near the player.
Examples:
[list]
[*][code][[NPCNear:Haley]]...Haley is within 5 tiles.
[/code]
[*][code][[NPCNear:Haley,Alex,r=8]]...Haley and Alex is within 8 tiles.
[/code]
[/list][code]r=8 is within 5 tiles,
[/code] ﻿[[NPCNear:Gus,this scope=loc]]Gus is currently on the map.


[line]How Token Combining Works (AND)If you place multiple tokens in a row, they work as [b]AND[/b]:
[list]
[*]All conditions must match for the text to show.
[*]Order does not matter.
[/list]Example:
[code][[L:forest]][[IO:in]][[T:morning]]Inside Marnie’s Ranch in the morning.[/code]
[line]How [code]II[/code] Works (Branching / First Match Wins)You can place multiple candidates in one line using [b][code]II[/code][/b]:
[list]
[*]The mod checks candidates [b]from left to right[/b]
[*]The [b]first matching[/b] candidate is shown
[/list]Example:
[code][[T:morning]]Morning II [[L:forest]][[IO:in]]Forest interior (Marnie’s Ranch) II [[L:forest]][[IO:out]]Cindersap Forest (outdoors) II Default[/code]
[line]Quick Examples[list]
[*]Indoor/Outdoor
[code][[IO:in]]Indoors.[/code][code][[IO:out]]Outdoors.[/code][*]Time
[code][[T:>=1800]]After 6 PM.[/code][code][[T:2300-0200]]Late night.[/code][*]Location
[code][[L:saloon]]Crowded here.[/code][*]Heart
[code][[H:>=8]]Okay, you can talk now.[/code][*]Nearby NPC
[code][[NPCNear:Alex,r=5]]Alex is working out again?[/code][/list][line]FAQ (Please Read Before Asking)[b]Q: “Content Patcher says there is no content.json.”[/b]
A: You installed this like a CP pack. [b]Don’t.[/b] This is a [b]SMAPI mod[/b] (DLL). Put it in your [b]Mods[/b] folder like any other SMAPI mod.
[b]Q: “Nothing happens.”[/b]
A: Make sure your dialogue line actually contains tokens like [code][[T:...]][/code] in the [b]final output text[/b] (after CP/i18n).
[b]Q: “Do I have to use i18n?”[/b]
A: No. Works with i18n or CP. It reads the final displayed dialogue string.
